  • Missed safeguarding: prepubertal genital complaints warrant sensitive screening for irritants/abuse; not addressed.
  • Diarrhea may be antibiotic-associated or resolving viral; unnecessary antiprotozoals add adverse-effect risk.
  • No hygiene counseling; excoriations raise risk of secondary infection.
- Conclusion: The reasoning and likely management are unsafe and risk harm through incorrect treatment and missed important evaluations.
